equity.level_reason: Age only defines the surveillance population (AFP in persons aged <15 years) and the coverage indicator (by age 12 months); groups compared are countries, provinces, years and virus types, not SPDs.

level_alternative.reason: Security challenges and health access in reservoir areas are offered as explanations, which could be read as structural determinants, though tied to geography rather than social position.

ev.q: Case-based surveillance for AFP in persons aged <15 years is the primary means for detecting WPV and cVDPV transmission.

equity.equity_measurement: Comparisons are by country and province only (geography, not an SPD); security and health-access challenges are cited for reservoir areas.

notes: Coverage figures are WHO/UNICEF estimates cited from the Immunization Dashboard; the report's own analysis is of POLIS case and ES counts. Percent changes and positivity are hand-computed arithmetic, so no procedures are recorded. Design is inferred: descriptive surveillance with monitoring against GPEI goals and AFP indicator targets.
